finance_puzzle.question: A company has Revenue = ₹1200 Cr, EBITDA margin = 20%, Debt = ₹500 Cr, Interest rate = 8%. What happens to profit (before tax) if revenue falls 5%?
finance_puzzle.answer:
Old EBITDA = ₹240 Cr → Profit before interest cost of ₹40 Cr = ₹200 Cr.
New revenue = ₹1140 Cr → New EBITDA = ₹228 Cr → New profit before tax = ₹188 Cr.
That's a change of ₹-12 Cr — notice how a 5% revenue fall swings profit by a much bigger percentage. That's operating leverage.
